Dev.releaseNotes:
`feat` (`abstractions`): **Expose the season calendar's bounds**:

- Added two `IAiringCalendarService.GetSeasonBounds` overloads returning `SeasonBounds`: the season a day falls in, and a given season
- With a type, a season starts by that type's lead-in, as the calendar files entries; without one, it is the calendar quarter

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.144**.

`fix`: **Keep a series' cached air and end dates whole across threads**:

- `AnimeSeries.AirDate` and `EndDate` cached a `PartialDateOnly?` in plain fields; the struct is too large to be written in one step, so a concurrent first read could see it half-written and `ToDateOnly` threw
- The cached dates are now published through a box, so a reader sees all of a date or none

`fix` (`db`): **Index `AniDB_Anime_Staff` by anime**.

`fix`: **Register the plugins' web UIs after an earlier read of the web UIs**:

- A read of the web UIs before the plugins handed in theirs kept a list of the server's own alone, and the plugins' web UIs were then never registered
- Answered such a read without keeping it, registered the plugins' web UIs whatever was read before, and worked out what is served again once they are in

`fix` (`api`): **Make the release list admin-only**:

- `GET /api/v3/ReleaseInfo/Release` listed every stored release to any signed-in user, so a user with restricted tags could read the releases of series hidden from them
- Limited the route to administrators, as the other routes listing the whole release store are

`fix`: **Answer a transform's refusal to start a stream as the refusal**:

- The stream start endpoints answered every `StreamResourceException` from `GetRenditionAsync` with a 500
- Answered it through `StreamRenditionResponses.Refused` (400, 404 or 503), as a running session's resources already are
- Treated a refusal while restoring a session as the session being gone

`fix`: **Move links to directories on Windows**:

- `MoveFile` moved a link to a directory with `File.Move`, which finds no file there on Windows
- Moved and replaced such links as the directory entries they are, never what they point to

`fix`: **Leave movie markers and leading punctuation out of sort names**:

- `ToSortName` folded the accents of Latin letters and full-width forms
- Skipped leading punctuation (not symbols), a leading "Gekijouban" in any spelling or `劇場版`, then an article, each only when more title follows
- Matched the skipped words ignoring case

Closes #33

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Treat symbolic links to directories as links in listings and moves**:

- `FileSystemEntry` takes `bool? isDirectory`; `null` reads `IsDirectory` through `Stat` on first access
- Listings stat through a link up front only when following links, listing one kind, or leaving out a kind of link
- On Unix, `MoveFile` moves a link at either end with `rename(2)`, so a link to a directory is neither "not found" nor followed; another volume makes the link anew beside the destination and renames it over
- `SymbolicLinkStat.TargetStat`: what the link points to, one step and without following, read on first access

`fix` (`plugin`): **Check a dependency only against what the plugin takes from it**:

- A dependency's own copy of a third plugin's contracts no longer counts when the plugin's load context takes them from another dependency first, exporting or earlier in its order
- Applies to optional dependencies at the scan and to required ones after it

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Take `ManagedFolderScanOptions` in the scan methods**:

- `ScanManagedFolder`, `ScheduleScanForManagedFolder` and `ScheduleScanForManagedFolders` take a `ManagedFolderScanOptions` instead of their loose arguments
- `ScheduleScanForManagedFolders` now also takes `CheckFileSize`

`fix`: **Hash another name of a known file only once**:

- Hashing a new file first takes the video it is another name of (a hard link, or a symbolic link to a known location), reading nothing when every enabled hash is known and none was forced
- Two locations of one file on disk hashed at once share one read (`TryHashOnce`)

`feat`: **Group linked locations of a video and count duplicates by group**:

- Locations that are the same file (hard links, symbolic links with their file) are stored as one file group: `PrimaryLocationID` (own ID for a primary; `IVideoFile.PrimaryFileID`), `IsSymbolicLink`, `SymbolicLinkTarget`; kept up to date on detection, hashing, relocation, `NotifyVideoFileChangeDetected` and folder scans (`ManagedFolderScanOptions.RepairGroups`), and handed on when a primary is removed
- `Import.GroupLinkedFiles` (on by default) groups them; a location can be kept (`IVideoFile.IsKept`, `IVideoService.SetVideoFileKept`)
- Import de-duplication, `IVideoService.GetVideosWithDuplicates` and the `/api/v3/DuplicateFiles` routes count file groups (`VideoFileGroup`, `GetVideoFileGroups`) and only remove whole groups that are not preferred, so links are never left broken
- `File.Location` gives `IsKept`, `PrimaryID`, `IsPreferredGroup`, `IsSymbolicLink` and `SymbolicLinkTarget`, and with `includeStat` `IsBrokenLink` and the link's own `LinkStat` (also `IVideoFile.LinkStat`); `PUT /api/v3/File/Location/{locationID}/Keep` sets the flag
- Added the file group columns to `VideoLocal_Place`, filled for videos with more than one location on upgrade

`feat` (`relocation`): **Optionally replace the same video at the destination**:

- `ReplaceSameVideoAtDestination` (setting, preset manager, requests, APIv3 relocation settings, body and query; off by default) lets a relocation onto another copy of the same video go ahead
- A symbolic link there to the file is replaced by it; otherwise the moved file is removed after a size check

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.142**.

`fix` (`db`): **Read empty user tags as no tags**:

- `StringListConverter` drops empty entries, so an empty `UserTags` column reads as `[]` rather than `[""]`

`feat`: **Add episode kinds, source default orderings and ordering numbers**:

- Added `ExtraType` and `EpisodeCanonicity` to episodes, kept in the episode's extras
- Added `AbsoluteEpisodeNumber` per place, with `AbsoluteNumbering` on the ordering
- Kept the source's episode numbers per ordering entry; a shared number is a combined entry
- Added `IsSourceDefault`, `SourceDefaultCountries` and `GetSourceDefaultOrdering`
- Documented storing an alternative ordering for providers

`feat` (`abstractions`): **List several directories in one call**:

- Added `MaxDegreeOfParallelism` to `FileSystemListingOptions`
- Added `GetFileSystemEntriesByDirectory`, `GetFileEntriesByDirectory` and `GetDirectoryEntriesByDirectory`, walked in one parallel pool

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.143**.

`feat` (`api`): **Give API tokens a stable ID, a creation time and a last-use time**:

- `ApiToken` gained `ID`, `CreatedAt` and `LastUsedAt`, as init properties so its constructor is unchanged
- A token's use is written at most once per five minutes, from the authentication handler
- APIv3 lists the ID and times, and revokes a token by its ID at `DELETE /api/v3/Auth/Token/{tokenID}`
- Added the `CreatedAt` and `LastUsedAt` columns to `AuthTokens`

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.141**.

`fix` (`api`): **Settle the served APIs only once the web UIs are known**:

- Registering the controllers as services asked for them while the web host was built, which settled the APIs from the settings before any web UI could ask for one
- Before they are settled, every core controller is found and nothing is settled; a plugin reading `RunningApis` meanwhile gets what the settings say

`refactor` (`api`): **Turn the core APIs on and off without a restart**:

- A saved change to `EnableAPIv2`/`EnableAPIv3` applies at once: `ServedApis.Change` raises `Changed`, and `ServedApisChangeProvider` has MVC rebuild its routes
- The core's Swagger documents and the Swagger UI's list follow the APIs served
- `SHOKO_API_V2_ENABLED`/`SHOKO_API_V3_ENABLED` set the APIs at each start but may be overridden while the server runs
- Removed `ISystemService.ApisOnNextStart`, `CoreApiChangeRefusal.SetByEnvironment` and the web UI pick's refusal of an API an environment variable turned off

`feat` (`abstractions`): **List directories without a stat per entry, and say when a listing fails**:

- On Linux and macOS each entry's kind comes from `readdir_r`'s `d_type`, with a stat only through links and an lstat only where the file system gives no kind; no existence check before a listing
- `FileSystemListingOptions.ThrowOnError` throws for a missing or unreadable directory instead of leaving it out
- `IFileSystem.ReadSymbolicLink` reads a link's target as stored
- `CreateSymbolicLink` takes the link's kind, and then looks nothing up and allows a missing target

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.140**.

`fix` (`queue`): **Let a direct release search pass a queue held by hand**:

- Added `IQueueScheduler.IsJobTypeBlockedByFilters`, the acquisition filters without the holds set by hand
- A release search or preview run directly, which never touches the queue, only respects the filters, and a release search is queued while the queue is held, waiting with it

`chore` (`queue`): **Bump `Shoko.QueueProcessor` to `6.0.0-alpha.18`**.

`fix` (`plugin`): **Name a changed interface member instead of missing dependencies**:

- A plugin type that no longer implements a member of an interface it declares, as when the member's signature changed, is reported as built for another version, naming the type and the member

`fix` (`release`): **Pass by a provider whose source is down in a direct search**:

- A provider throwing `MetadataProviderUnavailableException` no longer fails the whole search: the next provider is asked, and the exception is answered only when none matched
- Documented that a provider whose source is down throws it rather than returning no match

`chore`: **Sort usings**.

`fix` (`tests`): **Let the remaining plugin and relocation tests pass on Windows**:

- The shared-contract test reads the plugin without its provider from a folder of its own, as Windows keeps the read contract locked
- The relocation test expects the source path in the resolved form the service now looks for

`fix` (`relocation`): **Compare a case-only rename's old and new paths in the same form**:

- The new path went through `Path.GetFullPath` and the old one did not, so on Windows a drive letter or separators kept them apart and a case-only rename was taken for a move

`fix` (`tests`): **Let the plugin and file system tests run on Windows**:

- The plugin tests' clean-up no longer fails on a plugin assembly Windows still holds locked
- The symbolic link tests skip only where links cannot be made, not on every Windows machine

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Hand out lazy `FileSystemEntry`s instead of `FileSystemInfo`s**:

- Added `FileSystemEntry`: path, name and kind from the listing, and a stat read only when asked for
- `IManagedFolderIgnoreRule.ShouldIgnore`, `FileSystemEntryFilter`, `VideoFileDetectedEventArgs.File` and `HashingRequest.File` take entries
- Replaced `GetFileSystemPaths` with `GetFileSystemEntries`, `GetFileEntries` and `GetDirectoryEntries`
- Moved the default members of `IFileSystem` into `FileSystemService`

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Take listing options, mark links and open files with stream options**:

- The listings take a `FileSystemListingOptions`, with links to directories walked only when asked (`FollowDirectoryLinks`) and once each, and file and directory links listed or left out apart
- `FileSystemEntry.IsSymbolicLink`, from the listing at no cost
- `IFileSystem.OpenFile(path, FileStreamOptions)`
- The listings now open long paths on Windows, through one pass per folder
- The empty-folder clean-up no longer walks into linked folders
- Removed two stale copies of the tables in the `IFileSystem` readme

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.139**.

`fix` (`filters`): **Read the watched episode counts by type for the current user**:

The six selectors never said they depend on the user, so a filter using only them got no user data and counted 0.

`fix` (`filters`): **Find series missing a permanent vote among the finished ones**:

Checked for series still airing instead, and counted a temporary vote as permanent.

`fix` (`filters`): **Give only the source every file shares as the shared video source**:

Gave the source of any file instead.

`fix` (`filters`): **Type the Years directory filter as years**.

`fix` (`filters`): **Keep the first filter expression of each name instead of failing every filter route**:

Mapped the expression types by name with `ToDictionary`, so a plugin's expression named like another stopped `FilterFactory` from starting. The core's own now win, then the first found.

`fix` (`filters`): **Refuse a filter parameter that does not parse instead of dropping its condition**:

Read numbers, dates and time spans in the server culture and turned a failure into no parameter, which left the condition out and widened the filter. They are now read and written invariantly, and a bad one is a validation error.

`fix` (`api`): **Describe log levels in the API spec as the names the server sends**.

`fix`: **Say why a release search found no provider to ask**:

Logged "No providers enabled" also when the providers given were all held, suspended or unable to auto-match.

`fix`: **Stop reporting a configuration's first read as a save by the reader**:

Writing the defaults of a configuration without a file raised `Saved` with every path changed and the reader as its actor, and a migration run while loading was credited to the reader too. Defaults are now written without the event, a migration's save has no actor, and the changed paths are worked out against the previous file as the configuration reads it, so a member the file left out and a save writes with its default no longer counts.

`fix` (`plugin`): **Apply a plugin migration older than one already applied without reverting the newer one**:

Applied each pending migration with `IMigrator.Migrate(target)`, which first reverts every applied migration that sorts after the target. A branch merged after another, bringing a migration with an older ID, rolled the newer one back, dropping its tables, and left it unapplied. Such migrations are now applied with the rest in one `Migrate()`, which reverts nothing.

`fix`: **Work out file-episode ranges again when a file of the episode is linked or unlinked**:

- Each `CrossRef_File_Episode` row kept the range from its first read, so files linked one at a time overlapped
- Saving or deleting a row now clears the cached range of every row of its episode

`fix` (`abstractions`): **Add the long path prefix to a Windows path only once in `EnsureUsablePath`**:

- A long path already prefixed with `\\?\` got a second prefix and could not be opened

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Expose the file system to plugins as `IFileSystem` and use it for library files**:

- `IFileSystemHelpers` became `IFileSystem` in the abstractions, grouped by files, directories and both, with `CopyFile`, `OpenFile`, `CreateHardLink`, `CreateSymbolicLink`, `ResolveSymbolicLink`, `IsDirectoryEmpty`, `GetFileSystemPaths` and a `FileSystemEntryFilter` delegate
- `GetStat` reads a file, directory or link in one call (`statx` on Linux) as `FileStat`, `DirectoryStat`, `SymbolicLinkStat` or `SpecialFileStat`, with `GetFileStat` and `GetDirectoryStat` beside it; it throws on errors other than a missing entry
- `GetVolumeMounts` lists the mounted volumes from the mount table alone, and `GetVolumeStat` reads the one an entry is on, sizes included; `/api/v3/Folder/MountPoints` lists through it
- `MoveFile` can replace a file, `MoveDirectory` renames, moves across volumes or merges, and both rename a name that only changes case through a temporary name; `CanCreateSymbolicLinks` tests a directory
- Changes made through it are hidden from the file watcher, which relocation no longer does itself
- `ResolveSymbolicLink` follows a chain to its final target, or only to the first, and throws `SymbolicLinkLoopException` for a loop or more than 40 links
- `IVideoFile.OnDiskUniqueID` became `Stat`; APIv3 file locations send it as `Stat` under the `Stat` include, which replaced `LocationUIDs` (`includeLocationUID` is now `includeStat`)
- The scan, hashing, the watcher, relocation, subtitles, Ogg durations, video streams, the core hasher and the managed folder checks read and change files through it
- A scan joins a new file that is a hard link of a known one to its video without hashing it
- A non-recursive `GetDirectoryPaths` no longer walks the whole tree

`fix`: **Keep the records of missing files while their managed folder's storage is gone**:

- "Remove Missing Files" removed every record of a managed folder whose share was unmounted
- A scan whose folder becomes unavailable after the listing stops instead of removing the rest
- `ManagedFolderPresence` checks the folder root is a non-empty directory, then that it stays on the same volume

`fix`: **Keep file watcher exclusions until the late reports of network shares are in**:

- An exclusion was lifted 2 seconds after its change, too soon for SMB and NFS, which report changes late or in batches
- Two changes to one path shared one exclusion, so the first to finish lifted it for both
- `WatcherExclusions` counts holds per path and lifts each 45 seconds after its release

`feat`: **Let a managed folder say it is on a network share, and give only those the long watcher grace period**:

- `IManagedFolder.IsNetworkShare`: `null` detects it from the volume, `true` or `false` says so; a new `IsNetworkShare` column on `ImportFolder`
- `IFileSystem.GetVolumeMount` finds the mount a path is on from the mount table alone, which the detection uses
- The file watcher ignores what the server changed for 45 seconds on a network share and 2 seconds elsewhere
- APIv3 managed folders take `IsNetworkShare` only when a request gives it, and show `IsDetectedNetworkShare`

`chore`: **Remove the unused stream debugging from `SubStream`**.

`refactor` (`db`): **Name the user, managed folder and file location tables and columns after their models**:

- `JMMUser` became `ShokoUser`, its table and its `JMMUserID` (now `ID`), and the user data tables' `JMMUserID` became `UserID`
- `ImportFolder` became `ShokoManagedFolder`, with `ID`, `Name` and `Path` columns
- `VideoLocal_Place`'s columns became `ID`, `VideoID`, `ManagedFolderID` and `RelativePath`, and `AniDB_Tag.TagName` became `TagNameSource`
- The avatar data fix and the duplicate file queries use the new names

`fix` (`api`): **Turn off the `/api/auth` routes when APIv2 and APIv3 are both off**.

`feat`: **Let a web UI declare the core APIs it needs, and keep them on while it is in use**:

- `IWebUIProvider.RequiredApis` (`CoreApis.V2`, `V3`); the Shoko Web UI needs APIv3
- `ISystemService.RunningApis`, `ApisOnNextStart`, `ApisNeededByWebUIs`, `ApisSetByEnvironment` and `SetApiEnabled`, which throws `CoreApiChangeRefusedException` for an API a web UI in use needs, or one an environment variable sets
- Picking a web UI turns on what it needs; at start, a missing one is turned on before the routes are built, unless an environment variable keeps it off, which warns
- Settings saves refuse the same, and APIv3's web UI models show `RequiredApis` and `MissingApis`

`repo` (`workflows`): **Run the unit tests on Windows too**.

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.138**.

`fix`: **Check a symbolic link's own extension when hashing it**:

Checked the name the video has in its managed folder instead of the link's target, which may be named anything.

`fix` (`scrobble`): **Save a user's data for a video one save at a time**:

Two saves of a video's new user data, such as two scrobbles sent at once, both inserted it, and the second failed on the unique key.

`fix` (`db`): **Remove groups without series and give orphaned series a group again**.

`fix`: **Save a new series and its new group together**:

Announced the new group only once its series is saved, and removed it again when saving the series fails, so a failed import no longer leaves a group without series.

`fix`: **Let one series at a time leave its group when deleting series**:

Two series of one group deleted at once could each still see the other, so neither removed the emptied group.

`fix` (`api`): **Give a log level rule the rule it replaced and drop `Final` from log level rules**:

- Made `Replaces` on `LogLevelRuleInfo` and the APIv3 `LogLevelRule` the replaced rule instead of its source, so a client can show and reset to the default a custom rule replaced
- Replaced `PluginID` and `PluginName` with the plugin's `Plugin` info, as the provider models give it
- Removed `Final`: a rule that was not final dropped nothing, since the targets come after every rule, so a rule with a `MaxLevel` is always final now
- Removed `final` from `AddLogLevelRule` and `Final` from the stored custom rules

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.137**.

`feat` (`plugin`): **Follow a release channel for plugin upgrades**:

- Added `Plugins.Updates.Channel` (`Auto`, `Stable`, `Dev`) and a per-plugin override in `PluginChannels`
- `Auto` follows the global channel, then the server's own; stable takes stable releases only, dev takes both
- The upgrades on start and while running, `GetAvailableUpdates` and the latest release of a package follow it
- Exposed through `IPluginPackageManager` and `/api/v3/Plugin/Package/Settings`

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.136**.
`fix` (`api`): **Keep `Final` on when a custom log level rule leaves it out**.
`fix` (`api`): **Name the log levels of the log level rules**.

`feat` (`plugin`): **Let plugins set default log level rules**:

- Added `AddLogLevelRule<TPlugin>`, applied between the core's defaults and the custom rules of the logging settings while the plugin is active
- Added `MinLevel` to a rule, writing a pattern's messages below the targets' levels
- Added `ILogService.GetLogLevelRules` and `GET /api/v3/Logging/Rules`, listing the rules in effect with their source
- Added getting, setting and removing the custom rules to `ILogService` and `/api/v3/Logging/Rules/Custom`

`fix` (`core`): **Drop the host's `Microsoft`, `System` and API logs below Warning**:

- Moved the web host's category filters into the core's default log level rules, since NLog's provider ignores category-only filters

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.135**.

`fix` (`api`): **Keep nullable and descriptions on model-typed properties in the OpenAPI documents**:

- Wrote a `$ref` with siblings as `allOf` through `UseAllOfToExtendReferenceSchemas`, since OpenAPI 3.0 ignores anything beside a bare `$ref`
- Had `EnumSchemaFilter` rewrite only the enum's own schema, not a property's `allOf` over it

`fix` (`config`): **Keep where a configuration's own exception was thrown**:

- Rethrew the exceptions `ConfigurationService` unwraps from reflection through `ExceptionDispatchInfo`, so their stack traces stop at the rethrow no more

`fix` (`config`): **Keep the configurations a plugin registers once it is initialized**:

- Read each registration through the plugin's current entry, since initializing a plugin replaces the inactive one it was taken with, which skipped every `AddConfiguration` type

`fix` (`api`): **Document reference members as nullable only when declared so**:

- Turned on `SupportNonNullableReferenceTypes`, so a member that is not `?` and not `[Required]` stops being written `nullable: true`

`fix` (`api`): **Name enum defaults as the enum's values in the OpenAPI documents**:

- Had `EnumSchemaFilter` rewrite a property's or parameter's default, written as a number or in another casing, to the wire name the enum lists

`fix` (`api`): **Mark a request body nullable when its parameter is**:

- Added `NullableRequestBodyFilter`, which writes the body's schema nullable for a parameter declared `?` or taking an empty body, and stops requiring a body that may be empty

`fix` (`images`): **Check an image's links without copying them**:

- Added `PocoIndex.Any`, which checks the entities under a key in place and stops at the first match.
- Read `ShokoImage.IsEnabled` and `IsDesired` through it, since an image shared by many entities, such as a source's placeholder, copied every link on each read.

`fix` (`airing`): **Build the AniDB airing dates once the server has started**:

- Made `AiringScheduleService` a hosted service that builds every AniDB anime's airing dates in the background once the server has started, since the first season or yearly-season read built them all and held up every other reader meanwhile.

`fix` (`config`): **Fail plugins whose configurations share a file**:

- Left out every configuration whose file another one also resolves to, compared ignoring case, and failed each plugin involved, naming the others.
- Threw for two of the core's own configurations sharing a file.

`feat` (`config`): **Register configuration types from a plugin's other assemblies**:

- Added `AddConfiguration<TPlugin, TConfig>`, so a plugin can tie a configuration type in its abstractions to itself, and other plugins can load it through `IConfigurationService`.
- Took a plugin's declared main configuration and its user configurations' types from any assembly it loaded itself.
- Failed a plugin registering a type from an assembly it does not own, or for another plugin's type.
- Took the registrations, and the user configuration ones, out of the service collection once read.

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.134**.

`fix` (`airing`): **List an airing once in a range read when only some of its schedules place it in AniDB**:

- `GetAiringsInRange` kept one target per episode key, and an episode's key came from the airing that found it. An episode only some of its schedules place in an AniDB anime got two keys, so each of its airings was listed twice.
- Episode targets are now gathered per episode, under the AniDB place when any airing gives one.

`fix` (`airing`): **Estimate a slot once when the source lists an episode it hasn't linked yet**:

- A schedule estimated a slot twice: once for its source's own episode there, and once for the AniDB episode its offset places there, when the source's episode was linked to none. Both estimates share one ID, so range, schedule and by-ID reads listed the airing twice.
- The estimate passes now leave out such an episode and estimate the slot for the placed AniDB episode only.

`fix` (`config`): **Leave read-only properties out of stored configurations**:

- Stopped storing properties without a setter, such as values computed for display, which were never read back.
- Added `IConfigurationService.Serialize(config, stripReadOnlyProperties)` and `StripReadOnlyProperties(token, type)` so plugins can do the same.

`feat` (`api`): **Let configuration reads leave out read-only properties**:

- Added `includeReadOnly` to `GET /api/v3/Configuration/{configID}` and `…/Default`; `false` leaves out the read-only properties, as stored.

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.133**.

`feat` (`core`): **Add a startup feed hub at `/signalr/startup`**:

- Sends the startup message backlog, then each new message and the start's state, while the server is not started
- Closes its connections once the server has started; refused afterwards, and guarded by the setup token while one is set

`fix` (`api`): **Name every SignalR event in camelCase and fix two feed leaks**:

- Image events read `series.imageAdded` and the like, and the plugin feed's `install-*` events `installQueued` and the like
- Queue pool detail only goes to connections on the `queue` feed, and a connection's opt-in is forgotten when it closes
- The logging hub follows a replaced logging configuration

`fix` (`core`): **Stop the auto-linker taking a film for its series**:

- A title and date match needs the starts within 60 days when both are known to the day, not the same year
- A film and a TV series are a type mismatch where a source keeps every entry apart
- A title cut down to words like "映画" or "Movie" no longer matches another title
- `RejudgeMetadataLinksJob` also judges links rated on a date and a title, as "Re-judge Dated Metadata Links"

`fix` (`plugin`): **Compare dependency ranges by semantic versioning**:

- `PluginVersionRange` orders versions as `SemverVersionComparer` does, so `0.1.0` satisfies `>=0.1.0.3`
- Ranges also take a prerelease as `-dev.N`, in the server, `shoko-build` and `Shoko.BuildTools.Targets`

`fix` (`abstractions`): **Count unset version parts as 0 in `SemverVersionComparer`**:

- `0.1.0` now equals `0.1.0.0` and sorts above `0.1.0.3`; only a revision above 0 is a prerelease
- `ToSemanticVersioningString` writes an unset build as 0

`fix` (`core`): **Keep the server up when a background service throws**:

- A plugin service waiting on a start that failed no longer stops the host, so failure mode keeps its web host

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.8.1**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.9.2**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Let a release provider answer only searches a person starts**:

- Added `CannotAutoMatchReason` to `IReleaseInfoProvider`, read through `ReleaseProviderInfo.CanAutoMatch`
- The core's own searches pass such a provider by and never queue its jobs
- Its availability reads the new `ManualOnly` kind, with the reason

`fix` (`core`): **Keep missing files on a scan for new files only**:

- `ScanManagedFolder` removed the records of missing files before looking at `onlyNewFiles`, so "Import New Files" and the new-files part of "Scan Managed Folders" dropped them too
- Invalid and orphaned records are still removed

`refactor` (`core`): **Drop `SENTRY_OPT_OUT` and leave reporting to the DSN**:

- Only `Sentry.Dsn` (`SHOKO_SENTRY_DSN`) decides now
- Settings migration 35 sets the DSN to `off` when `SENTRY_OPT_OUT` is true and no DSN is set

`feat` (`core`): **Report every plugin's errors when the reported plugin list is empty**:

- An empty `Sentry.ReportedPlugins` (`SHOKO_SENTRY_PLUGINS=[]`) now sends every plugin's errors to a DSN of your own instead of none

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Let a setup token protect setup and failure mode**:

- Added `Web.SetupToken` (`SHOKO_SETUP_TOKEN`), off while empty
- While set, setup and failure mode only take requests giving it as their API key
- `GET /api/v3/Init/Status` reports `RequiresSetupToken`
- Added `HasSetupToken` and `SetSetupToken` to `ISystemService`; setting saves the token and applies at once, refused while `SHOKO_SETUP_TOKEN` is set

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Keep enablement out of provider availability**:

- Removed `ProviderAvailabilityKind.Disabled` and renumbered the other kinds from 0
- A release provider's availability no longer depends on it being ticked for auto-linking, which `Enabled` already reports
- Relocation providers already ignored it

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.132**.

`fix` (`core`): **Carry the 5.x TMDB cast and network switches to the plugin**:

Migration 26 now also writes `AutoDownloadCrewAndCast` and
`AutoDownloadNetworks` as the plugin's `DownloadCastAndCrew` and
`DownloadNetworks`, so a switch turned off in 5.x stays off.

`feat` (`core`): **Give the TMDB cast copied from 5.x its characters**:

- The 5.x TMDB data copy makes a character stub for each cast credit, keyed by TMDB's credit ID as the TMDB plugin names them, and points the copied episode, movie, show and season cast at it

`fix` (`core`): **Read release percentages MySQL wrote as floats**:

- Read a stored release's `PercentageStart` and `PercentageEnd` written as `100.0`, as the release cross-references rewrite (schema step 205/1) left them on MySQL 8, which kept the server from starting

`fix` (`core`): **Apply the logging settings before the first start-up logs**:

- Moved unblocking the files and starting the telemetry below the logging, setup mode and culture settings, so the telemetry's rules are left as the export needs them
- Logged files that cannot be unblocked at debug level instead of as a warning

`refactor` (`core`): **Unblock only the server's executables on Windows**:

- Left the libraries' "downloaded from the internet" mark alone, since .NET loads them anyway; the executables still lose it, so Explorer, shortcuts and autostart do not ask before starting them

`chore` (`plugin`): **Quiet the plugin scan logs**:

- Dropped the trace line for each plugin assembly scanned for queue jobs, and logged skipped disabled plugins at debug level

`fix` (`core`): **Keep failing `WaitForStartupAsync` after a failed start**:

- Kept the startup task once it completes instead of dropping it, so a later caller gets the `StartupFailedException` rather than a completed task

`fix` (`core`): **Stop reporting third-party plugin failures to Sentry**:

- Decided by where the innermost exception was thrown: the first frame of the server or of a plugin, skipping the runtime's own frames
- Reported the server, its dependencies and the first-party plugins (Legacy Plex, TMDB, AniList, Offline Importer and WebAOM), told apart by their `PluginLoadContext`

`refactor` (`core`): **Move the Sentry settings into a `Sentry` section**:

- Replaced `SentryOptOut` with `Sentry.Dsn`: empty or `null` reports to the built-in DSN, an `http://` or `https://` DSN reports there from any build, and any other value turns reporting off; settings migration 34 turns an opt-out into `off`, and `SENTRY_OPT_OUT` still turns reporting off
- Added `Sentry.SampleRate` and `Sentry.ReportedPlugins`, which only apply with a DSN of the admin's own and are read-only in the UI until one is set
- Each has an environment variable: `SHOKO_SENTRY_DSN`, `SHOKO_SENTRY_SAMPLE_RATE` and `SHOKO_SENTRY_PLUGINS`
- Moved `DumpSettingsOnStart` to the end of the settings

`fix` (`tests`): **Register MSBuild once as the test assembly loads**:

- Moved the `MSBuildLocator` registration from four test classes' static constructors into a module initializer; a class loading MSBuild first made the registration throw when the classes ran in parallel

`fix` (`core`): **Pass the hashing cancellation on to the media info refresh**:

- Gave the second path in the unblock warning a placeholder of its own

`chore` (`tests`): **Drop the tests re-running plain schema steps**:

- Removed the tests that re-ran a schema step's SQL, found by a version pinned per backend, and the `SchemaSteps` lookup behind them
- The data fix tests stay and clean up the released tables and columns by plain SQL

`fix` (`api`): **Read the assumed file count from `PercentageGroupSize`**:

- Removed the copy of `PercentageToFileCount` in the APIv3 `FileCrossReference`, which only knew exact percentages, so a file covering 95% of an episode now counts as one of one instead of unknown

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Allow linking releases to entries of any source by metadata ID**:

- Typed the IDs of release cross-references as `MetadataGuid`s (`IDs`, replacing `ProviderIDs`), stored with the main entry first; schema steps rewrite the stored releases
- Releases link only series, episodes and movies, of any source
- Validated cross-references through plugin `IReleaseCrossReferenceValidator`s on save, the core's AniDB one first; corrections give IDs and optionally a range, and a range change is checked again by the validators that passed it
- Healed stored releases through the validators ("Download Missing Metadata for Files"), taking only their corrections
- Added lookups of releases and videos by any metadata ID, and `IMetadataVideoCrossReference`, one direct link per cross-reference to its main entry; seasons carry their episodes' links
- Added `IVideo.IsRecognized`, `IsManuallyLinked` and `IsInImportLimbo`: any stored release recognises a video, provisional included, a `User` release makes it manual, and limbo is a main entry or its series not readable yet; the sweeps, dashboard, APIv3 file filters, APIv2 `recognized` and the import scan follow them
- Added `IRelocationProvider.SupportsNonAnidbLinkedVideos`, off by default, for files linked only to other sources than AniDB; `SupportsUnrecognized` still covers unrecognised files and `SupportsIncompleteMetadata` files in import limbo
- Kept entries a release names in use for the purge and refresh, and listed their files in the entry and TMDB file routes; the APIv3 `File` and the file events carry their `MetadataCrossReferences`
- Queued the refresh of the series or movie of each entry of another source a saved release names, and included them in the bulk refreshes, image downloads and collection fetches
- Counted directly linked files on the calendar, kept such files' events from restricted users, used their entries' folders for relocation, and carried watched state between files of one entry
- Made `shoko-build` tag a plugin implementing a validator with `release-validator`

`fix` (`core`): **Skip a release provider suspended while searching**:

- A release search stops waiting on a provider that gets suspended while it searches, such as AniDB once its UDP login fails, and asks the next one, instead of failing or blocking the whole search
- The last provider is waited on and fails as before

`feat` (`api`): **Answer a 502 naming the release provider that failed a preview**:

- Added `ReleaseProviderFailedException`, thrown by `FindReleaseForVideo` when a provider fails the search
- `/api/v3/ReleaseInfo/File/{fileID}/AutoPreview` answers a 502 validation problem keyed `providerIDs[<provider ID>]`

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Test the database connection and set the default user through `ISystemService`**:

- Added `TestDatabaseConnection`, testing the current or given server settings with why it failed
- Added `SetDefaultUserCredentials`, refused outside setup mode
- `/api/v3/Init/Database/Test` uses the former

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Replace the client data of video user data with user tags**:

- Replaced `IVideoUserData.ClientData` with `UserTags`, set through `VideoUserDataUpdate.UserTags` and `IUserDataService.AddUserTagsForVideo`, `RemoveUserTagsForVideo` and `SetUserTagsForVideo`, as for episodes and series
- Schema steps drop the `ClientData` column and add `UserTags`; nothing is carried over
- Removed the `/api/v3/File/{fileID}/UserData/ClientData` routes; the file user data and its SignalR event carry `UserTags`

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Let seasons carry resources and resources a title of their own**:

- `ISeason` is `IWithResources`, empty by default; providers write season links through `MetadataSeasonData.Resources`, stored with the season
- Added `Resource.Title` beside `Name`, the site or service
- APIv3 seasons and resources carry them, with a `Season/{id}/Resources` route

`feat` (`core`): **Add a "Download Missing Linked Metadata" action**:

- Queued a refresh of each series or film an anime in the library links to on an enabled provider's source that is not stored, and of the series of each linked episode not stored
- Queued the AniDB anime of linked series in the library that are not stored
- No default trigger, as for "Download Missing AniDB Anime Data"

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.131**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.9.1**.

`feat` (`buildtools`): **Add manifest write hooks for release extensions**:

- `shoko-build` runs `ShokoBeforeAssetWrite` once per runtime with the pending archive, then `ShokoBeforeReleaseWrite` once per release with the whole release, and takes back only their `extensions`
- `ShokoAfterReleaseWrite` runs once per release after the manifest is saved
- Nothing extra runs when no target attaches to them

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.9.0**.
